title: Belt Making in Barcelona!
text: The belt making class was fantastic! Diletta was very nice and explained everything very well, she is extremely knowledgeable about the craft and Barcelona! Totally worth the price!
author: 971eliv

title: Fun Leather Projects Become Great Souvenirs
text:
The guys made custom leather belts and the girls made custom leather purses. It was a fun few hours, and we are returning home with special (and useful) non-cheesy souvenirs that will always remind us of our time in Barcelona.

Note: It is a little tricky to find. The uber/taxi couldn't drive us there.
author: HuntingtonBeachBlond

title: Creation of belts:)
text: Great workshop, we made 2 beautiful belts with precise advice and in a very good Mood. My 12-year-old daughter was thrilled. We had a great afternoon, we will be back with pleasure!
author: 361paulyac

title: Would recommend!
text: Easy project to give confidence in a fun craft. The shop was clean, the host was engaging, and the product is usable. ----@@@---@@@---@@@---@@@
author: julieanne s

title: Mother and Daughter Workshop
text: This was a great mother and adult daughter experience  learning how to create something together.  Lovely tutor and welcoming store.  Has inspired me to seek out more workshop experiences.  My daughter wanted to buy a belt but this is even better getting to make your own and personalising it!
author: GetSmart9949

title: So fun!
text: What a great location and store. It was such a fun activity.  We met new people, learned something new. And I love my belt!
author: ROBIN_A
